top_signals.title: Brent Flash Crashes $6 Before Rebounding Towards $104
top_signals.summary: Brent crude plunged more than $6 per barrel Tuesday morning, falling from $107.24 to $100.80 before recovering to around $103.46 shortly after 10 a.m. Eastern, as traders reacted to a succession of conflicting reports about U.S.-Iran peace negotiations. The selloff followed Monday's 7.6% decline, which left Brent at $104.77. Prices initially rebounded overnight after reports of U.S. strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island, near the Strait of Hormuz, before reversing sharply Tuesday morning. top_signals.title: Binance says hackers used fake job interview, internal AI tool in $6.3 billion breach
top_signals.summary: Binance's incident report said hackers used a fake job interview and an internal AI tool to gain access to systems involved in the theft.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: CFTC approves individual stock perpetual futures trading in US for the first time
top_signals.summary: The CFTC approved the ability for exchanges in the U.S. to offer perpetual futures contracts tied to individual stocks.
